pages.title: Cheese Grater
pages.text: Race 1 of 12: Vancouver, 7.2 km. At about 177 beats a minute, the fastest song in the game. Secret password to start here: TOTEM, for the totem poles of Stanley Park. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Home track
pages.text: Skitchin' was made here, at EA Canada in Burnaby, once Distinctive Software. Designer Dave Warfield remembers inline skaters crowding the Stanley Park seawall in 1994.

pages.title: Learner's lane
pages.text: A tip hidden in the game: Vancouver is the best place to learn skitching, as the cars always keep to the left lane. Skate on the centre line and grab one as it passes.

pages.title: Age 13
pages.text: Jeff grew up here. His father, a studio musician and a Roland engineer, brought home prototype synths and drum machines, then left his son a whole 8-track studio in his bedroom, at 13.
